WITH sessions_with_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    device.deviceCategory,
    visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as hits
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND totals.transactions > 0
),
first_trans_per_visitor AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_trans_date
  FROM sessions_with_trans
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_visit_per_visitor AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_trans_session AS (
  SELECT 
    st.fullVisitorId,
    st.date,
    st.deviceCategory,
    st.visitId,
    st.visitStartTime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY st.fullVisitorId, st.date ORDER BY st.visitStartTime) as rn
  FROM sessions_with_trans st
  JOIN first_trans_per_visitor ft ON st.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId AND st.date = ft.first_trans_date
)
SELECT 
  fts.fullVisitorId,
  fvp.first_visit_date,
  fts.date as first_trans_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fts.date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fvp.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  fts.deviceCategory
FROM first_trans_session fts
JOIN first_visit_per_visitor fvp ON fts.fullVisitorId = fvp.fullVisitorId
WHERE fts.rn = 1
ORDER BY fts.fullVisitorId

WITH product_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    date,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY traffic_source, date
),
max_daily AS (
  SELECT MAX(daily_revenue_millions) AS max_daily_revenue_millions
  FROM product_hits
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK) AS week_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY week_start
),
max_weekly AS (
  SELECT MAX(weekly_revenue_millions) AS max_weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM weekly_revenue
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month_start
),
max_monthly AS (
  SELECT MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) AS max_monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  (SELECT max_daily_revenue_millions FROM max_daily) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT max_weekly_revenue_millions FROM max_weekly) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT max_monthly_revenue_millions FROM max_monthly) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions

WITH product_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    t.date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId, t.date
),
all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
SELECT 
  SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 6) AS month,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.transactions >= 1 AND COALESCE(p.has_product_revenue, 0) = 1 THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN a.transactions IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.has_product_revenue, 0) = 0 THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS session_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.fullVisitorId) AS visitor_count,
  AVG(a.pageviews) AS avg_pageviews
FROM all_sessions a
LEFT JOIN product_hits p 
  ON a.fullVisitorId = p.fullVisitorId AND a.visitId = p.visitId AND a.date = p.date
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS s,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%you tube%'
)
SELECT 
  vp.v2ProductName,
  SUM(vp.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM visitor_products vp
INNER JOIN youtube_buyers yb ON yb.fullVisitorId = vp.fullVisitorId
GROUP BY vp.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
z_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    d.date,
    d.daily_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(d.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_counts d, stats s
)
SELECT date, daily_count, z_score, rn
FROM z_scores
WHERE rn = 2

WITH target_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId, visitId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
),
all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.page.pagePath,
    h.time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  INNER JOIN target_sessions t ON s.fullVisitorId = t.fullVisitorId AND s.visitId = t.visitId
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, pagePath, time,
    LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_page_path,
    LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM all_page_hits
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
most_common_next AS (
  SELECT next_page_path
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_page_path
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(next_time - time), 1000)) AS INT64) as max_time_seconds
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT mcn.next_page_path AS most_common_next_page, mt.max_time_seconds
FROM most_common_next mcn
CROSS JOIN max_time mt

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) AS max_monthly,
    MIN(monthly_revenue_millions) AS min_monthly
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  max_monthly,
  min_monthly,
  ROUND(max_monthly - min_monthly, 2) AS diff
FROM stats

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName = "YouTube Men's Vintage Henley"
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
),
customer_purchases AS (
  SELECT qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM qualifying_customers qc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s ON qc.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.v2ProductName != "YouTube Men's Vintage Henley"
  GROUP BY qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM customer_purchases
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201231' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC

WITH top_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(AVG(start_station_latitude), 3) as start_lat_3,
    ROUND(AVG(start_station_longitude), 3) as start_lon_3,
    ROUND(AVG(end_station_latitude), 3) as end_lat_3,
    ROUND(AVG(end_station_longitude), 3) as end_lon_3,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
    AND tripduration > 0
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_by_route AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat_3,
    ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon_3,
    ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat_3,
    ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon_3,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE dropoff_datetime IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_datetime IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND trip_distance > 0
  GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
  tr.start_station_name,
  tr.end_station_name,
  tr.avg_bike_duration,
  ts.avg_taxi_duration
FROM top_routes tr
JOIN taxi_by_route ts 
  ON tr.start_lat_3 = ts.start_lat_3 
  AND tr.start_lon_3 = ts.start_lon_3
  AND tr.end_lat_3 = ts.end_lat_3
  AND tr.end_lon_3 = ts.end_lon_3
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ts.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_seconds / 60.0 AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
  geo_id,
  ROUND(avg_donation, 2) AS avg_donation,
  median_income
FROM (
  SELECT 
    xwalk.census_tract_geoid AS geo_id,
    AVG(fec.transaction_amt) AS avg_donation,
    acs.median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` AS fec
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` AS xwalk
    ON LEFT(fec.zip_code, 5) = xwalk.zip_code
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` AS acs
    ON xwalk.census_tract_geoid = acs.geo_id
  WHERE fec.state = 'NY'
    AND xwalk.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
  GROUP BY xwalk.census_tract_geoid, acs.median_income
)
ORDER BY geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, c.state_code, c.condition_status_code,
         SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1)) as subplot_acres,
         SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 1)) as macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
    AND c.survey_unit_code = p.survey_unit_code
    AND c.county_code = p.county_code
    AND c.phase_2_plot_number = p.phase_2_plot_number
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, c.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
condition_totals AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code,
         SUM(subplot_acres) as total_subplot_acres,
         SUM(macroplot_acres) as total_macroplot_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  GROUP BY evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code
),
best_condition_per_group AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code, total_subplot_acres, total_macroplot_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_totals
),
best_conditions AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code, total_subplot_acres, total_macroplot_acres
  FROM best_condition_per_group
  WHERE rn = 1
),
best_eval_type AS (
  SELECT ca.evaluation_group, ca.evaluation_group_description, ca.evaluation_type, ca.evaluation_description, ca.condition_status_code, ca.state_code, ca.subplot_acres, ca.macroplot_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.evaluation_group ORDER BY ca.subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres ca
  JOIN best_conditions bc
    ON ca.evaluation_group = bc.evaluation_group
    AND ca.condition_status_code = bc.condition_status_code
)
SELECT bc.evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group, bet.evaluation_type, bc.condition_status_code, bet.evaluation_description, bc.state_code, bc.total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres, bc.total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM best_conditions bc
JOIN best_eval_type bet
  ON bc.evaluation_group = bet.evaluation_group
  AND bet.rn = 1
ORDER BY bc.total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY country_name
),
total_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS midyear_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under20,
  t.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under20, t.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under20
FROM under20 u
JOIN total_pop t ON u.country_name = t.country_name
ORDER BY pct_under20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10') AND aggregation_level = 0 AND subregion1_code IS NULL AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000 AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) * 5.0 / 9.0 - 17.7778 AS temp_c,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01','02','03')
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM rochester_data
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    temp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_temp,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_temp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_prcp,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_prcp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_wdsp,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_wdsp,

WITH same_station AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    starttime,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as next_start,
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as prev_start
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
trip_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id as end_station_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120 THEN 1
      WHEN next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as is_group_trip
  FROM same_station
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    SUM(is_group_trip) as group_trips
  FROM trip_groups
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      end_station_id, 
      end_station_name,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.end_station_id,
    sn.end_station_name,
    gc.group_trips,
    tc.total_trips_ending,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trips, tc.total_trips_ending) as proportion,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trips, tc.total_trips_ending) DESC) as rn
  FROM group_counts gc
  JOIN total_counts tc ON gc.end_station_id = tc.end_station_id
  JOIN station_names sn ON gc.end_station_id = sn.end_station_id
)
SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name, group_trips, total_trips_ending, proportion

WHERE rn <= 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,

    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.mta_tax,

  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dbo
    ON t.pickup_location_id = dbo.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND dbo.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN tip_amount = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END AS tip_category
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  COUNT(*) AS num_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)) AS proportion
FROM classified
GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
ORDER BY pickup_borough, 
  CASE tip_category
    WHEN 'no tip' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Less than 5%' THEN 2
    WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
    WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
    WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
    WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
    WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
  END

WITH users_2021 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
user_first_question AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.creation_date,
    u.signup_month,
    MIN(p.creation_date) AS first_question_date
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` p ON u.user_id = p.owner_user_id
  WHERE p.creation_date BETWEEN u.creation_date AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.creation_date, u.signup_month
),
user_first_answer_after_first_question AS (
  SELECT 
    uq.user_id,
    uq.first_question_date,
    MIN(a.creation_date) AS first_answer_date
  FROM user_first_question uq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON uq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > uq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(uq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY uq.user_id, uq.first_question_date
),
total_users_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_new_users
  FROM users_2021
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
asked_question_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS users_asked_question
  FROM user_first_question
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
answered_question_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    uq.signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS users_who_answered_within_30_days
  FROM user_first_question uq
  JOIN user_first_answer_after_first_question ua ON uq.user_id = ua.user_id
  GROUP BY uq.signup_month
)
SELECT 
  t.signup_month,
  t.total_new_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(a.users_asked_question * 100.0, t.total_new_users) AS pct_asked_question,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(e.users_who_answered_within_30_days * 100.0, a.users_asked_question) AS pct_answered_within_30_days_of_first_question
FROM total_users_per_month t
LEFT JOIN asked_question_per_month a ON t.signup_month = a.signup_month
LEFT JOIN answered_question_per_month e ON t.signup_month = e.signup_month
ORDER BY t.signup_month

WITH 
-- Get daily average temperature from both stations (2008-2017)
daily_temp AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date
),
-- Get daily complaint counts per type
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) AS date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date, complaint_type
),
-- Get total daily complaints
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) AS date,
    COUNT(*) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date
),
-- Get complaint types with > 5000 total occurrences
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000
),
-- Join everything together
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.avg_temp,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.complaint_count,
    d.total_daily_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.complaint_count, d.total_daily_complaints) * 100 as pct_complaints
  FROM daily_temp t
  JOIN daily_totals d ON t.date = d.date
  JOIN daily_complaints c ON t.date = c.date
  JOIN qualifying_types q ON c.complaint_type = q.complaint_type
),
-- Compute all metrics per complaint type
metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as num_days,
    SUM(complaint_count) as total_complaints,
    -- Pearson correlation for complaint count vs temp
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * complaint_count) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(complaint_count)) 
    / NULLIF(SQRT(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(avg_temp))
      * (COUNT(*) * SUM(complaint_count * complaint_count) - SUM(complaint_count) * SUM(complaint_count))
    ), 0) as corr_temp_count,
    -- Pearson correlation for percentage vs temp
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * pct_complaints) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(pct_complaints)) 
    / NULLIF(SQRT(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(avg_temp))
      * (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_complaints * pct_complaints) - SUM(pct_complaints) * SUM(pct_complaints))
    ), 0) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  num_days,
  total_complaints,
  ROUND(corr_temp_count, 4) as corr_temp_count,
  ROUND(corr_temp_pct, 4) as corr_temp_pct
FROM metrics
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type

    dp.complaint_type,
    dp.proportion,
    ws.avg_wind_speed
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_speed ws ON dp.complaint_date = ws.weather_date
),
corr_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(proportion) as sum_x,
    SUM(avg_wind_speed) as sum_y,
    SUM(proportion * avg_wind_speed) as sum_xy,
    SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_x2,
    SUM(avg_wind_speed * avg_wind_speed) as sum_y2
  FROM correlated
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
corr_results AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    (sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y / n) / 
      SQRT((sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x / n) * (sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y / n)) as pearson_correlation
  FROM corr_stats
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(pearson_correlation, 4) as pearson_correlation
FROM corr_results
WHERE complaint_type IN (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM corr_results ORDER BY pearson_correlation DESC LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(pearson_correlation, 4) as pearson_correlation
FROM corr_results
WHERE complaint_type IN (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM corr_results ORDER BY pearson_correlation ASC LIMIT 1
)

monthly_sales AS (

WITH daily_prcp AS (

daily_trips AS (

combined AS (

-- Full query: compute difference per species, then group by fall_color
WITH species_list AS (
    SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) as upper_name, fall_color
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
    WHERE fall_color IS NOT NULL
),
count_1995 AS (
    SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
    WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT upper_name FROM species_list)
    AND status != 'Dead'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
count_2015 AS (
    SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT upper_name FROM species_list)
    AND status = 'Alive'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s.upper_name,
        s.fall_color,
        COALESCE(c2.cnt, 0) - COALESCE(c1.cnt, 0) as difference
    FROM species_list s
    LEFT JOIN count_1995 c1 ON s.upper_name = c1.upper_spc
    LEFT JOIN count_2015 c2 ON s.upper_name = c2.upper_spc
)
SELECT 
    fall_color,
    SUM(difference) as total_change
FROM species_diff
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH trees_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    CASE WHEN SPLIT(spc_common, '-')[OFFSET(0)] IS NOT NULL THEN SPLIT(spc_common, '-')[OFFSET(0)] ELSE spc_common END AS common_name,
    status,
    CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_alive,
    CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
),
trees_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common AS common_name,
    status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_alive,
    CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
),
agg_1995 AS (
  SELECT latin_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(is_alive) AS alive_count,
    SUM(is_dead) AS dead_count
  FROM trees_1995
  GROUP BY latin_name
),
agg_2015 AS (
  SELECT latin_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(is_alive) AS alive_count,
    SUM(is_dead) AS dead_count
  FROM trees_2015
  GROUP BY latin_name
),
common_names AS (
  SELECT latin_name, 
    common_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin_name ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT latin_name, common_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trees_1995 GROUP BY latin_name, common_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT latin_name, common_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trees_2015 GROUP BY latin_name, common_name
  )
)
SELECT 
  a19.latin_name,
  cn.common_name,
  a19.total_count AS total_1995,
  a15.total_count AS total_2015,
  a19.alive_count AS alive_1995,
  a15.alive_count AS alive_2015,
  a19.dead_count AS dead_1995,
  a15.dead_count AS dead_2015,
  a15.total_count - a19.total_count AS total_growth,
  a15.alive_count - a19.alive_count AS alive_growth,
  a15.dead_count - a19.dead_count AS dead_growth
FROM agg_1995 a19
JOIN agg_2015 a15 ON a19.latin_name = a15.latin_name
JOIN common_names cn ON a19.latin_name = cn.latin_name AND cn.rn = 1
ORDER BY (a15.total_count - a19.total_count) DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH google_hiring AS (

  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) as avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) as avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) as avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) as avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND industry IS NULL
    AND (
      (subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (subsector = 'Software publishers' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (subsector = 'Data processing, hosting, and related services' AND industry_group IS NULL)
      OR (industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
    )
)
SELECT 
  race,
  ROUND(google_pct * 100, 1) as google_pct,
  ROUND(bls_avg_pct * 100, 1) as bls_avg_pct,
  ROUND(abs_diff * 100, 1) as percentage_difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    'White' as race,
    g.race_white as google_pct,
    b.avg_white as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_white - b.avg_white) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Asian' as race,
    g.race_asian as google_pct,
    b.avg_asian as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_asian - b.avg_asian) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black or African American' as race,
    g.race_black as google_pct,
    b.avg_black as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_black - b.avg_black) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latinx' as race,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx as google_pct,
    b.avg_hispanic as bls_avg_pct,
    ABS(g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic) as abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech_avg b
)
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 3

berkeley_trips AS (

SELECT

WITH target_point AS (
  SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833) AS pt
),
zip_codes_in_radius AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, z.zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z, target_point t
  WHERE ST_DISTANCE(z.internal_point_geom, t.pt) < 5 * 1609.344
    AND z.state_name = 'Washington'
),
tracts_with_income AS (
  SELECT 
    t.geo_id,
    t.tract_geom,
    a.total_pop,
    a.income_per_capita,
    a.total_pop * a.income_per_capita AS total_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` a
    ON t.geo_id = a.geo_id
  WHERE a.total_pop IS NOT NULL AND a.total_pop > 0
),
allocations AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)) AS proportion,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)) * tr.total_pop AS allocated_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)) * tr.total_income AS allocated_income
  FROM tracts_with_income tr
  JOIN zip_codes_in_radius z
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 1) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) AS average_individual_income
FROM allocations
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY average_individual_income DESC

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year, 
         County_of_Residence_FIPS,
         SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
         SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY birth_year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
pct AS (
  SELECT birth_year, County_of_Residence_FIPS,
         CAST(no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(total_births, 0) as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM natality
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT p.birth_year, p.pct_no_morbidity, c.poverty_rate
  FROM pct p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2016 as census_year FROM census_2015
    UNION ALL
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2017 as census_year FROM census_2016
    UNION ALL
    SELECT geo_id, poverty_rate, 2018 as census_year FROM census_2017
  ) c ON p.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id AND p.birth_year = c.census_year
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  birth_year as year,
  CORR(poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity) as pearson_correlation
FROM combined
GROUP BY birth_year
ORDER BY birth_year

WITH accident_persons AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) as num_distinct_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_fatalities
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
accident_filter AS (
  SELECT state_number, consecutive_number, num_fatalities
  FROM accident_persons
  WHERE num_distinct_persons > 1
),
vehicle_speeds AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number,
    CAST(travel_speed AS INT64) as travel_speed,
    CAST(speed_limit AS INT64) as speed_limit
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE CAST(travel_speed AS INT64) NOT IN (997, 998, 999)
    AND CAST(speed_limit AS INT64) NOT IN (98, 99)
    AND travel_speed IS NOT NULL
    AND speed_limit IS NOT NULL
),
speed_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number,
    AVG(CAST(ABS(CAST(travel_speed AS INT64) - CAST(speed_limit AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64)) as avg_speed_diff
  FROM vehicle_speeds
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
vehicle_body_types AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, consecutive_number, vehicle_number, body_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_number, consecutive_number ORDER BY vehicle_number) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
),
body_type_per_accident AS (
  SELECT state_number, consecutive_number, body_type
  FROM vehicle_body_types
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  af.state_number,
  bt.body_type,
  a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN a.work_zone != 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as work_zone,
  CASE 
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN sd.avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END as speed_level,
  CASE WHEN af.num_fatalities > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as label
FROM accident_filter af
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a 
  ON af.state_number = a.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
JOIN body_type_per_accident bt 
  ON af.state_number = bt.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = bt.consecutive_number
LEFT JOIN speed_diff sd 
  ON af.state_number = sd.state_number AND af.consecutive_number = sd.consecutive_number

WITH unemployment_2015 AS (

),
unemployment_2018 AS (

),
dual_2015 AS (

  WHERE Date = '2015-12-01'

dual_2018 AS (

county_comparison AS (

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Hiring' AS data_source,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women AS percent_women,
    gender_us_men AS percent_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Representation' AS data_source,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women AS percent_women,
    gender_us_men AS percent_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    'BLS Technology Sectors' AS data_source,
    SUM(percent_asian * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_asian,
    SUM(percent_black_or_african_american * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_black,
    SUM(percent_hispanic_or_latino * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_hispanic_latinx,
    SUM(percent_white * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS race_white,
    SUM(percent_women * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS percent_women,
    1 - SUM(percent_women * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) AS percent_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND (subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' 
         OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
)
SELECT 
  data_source,
  ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
  ROUND(race_black * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
  ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
  ROUND(race_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
  ROUND(percent_women * 100, 1) AS women_pct,
  ROUND(percent_men * 100, 1) AS men_pct
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM google_hiring
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM google_representation
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM bls_tech
)
ORDER BY 
  CASE data_source 
    WHEN 'Google Overall Hiring' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Google Overall Representation' THEN 2
    WHEN 'BLS Technology Sectors' THEN 3
  END

WITH latest_eval AS (

  )
),
latest AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
  FROM latest_eval WHERE rn = 1
),
pop_filtered AS (
  SELECT p.plot_sequence_number, p.state_code, p.evaluation_group_sequence_number, p.evaluation_group,
         p.expansion_factor, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest l ON p.state_code = l.state_code AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = l.evaluation_group_sequence_number

),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT pf.state_code, pf.evaluation_group, c.state_code_name, c.condition_status_code, c.reserved_status_code, c.site_productivity_class_code, c.proportion_basis,
         pf.expansion_factor, c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
         CASE 
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
           ELSE NULL
         END as adj_factor
  FROM pop_filtered pf
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pf.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number AND pf.state_code = c.state_code
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group,
       SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 
                AND adj_factor IS NOT NULL 
                THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adj_factor ELSE 0 END) as timberland_acres,
       SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 
                AND adj_factor IS NOT NULL 
                THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adj_factor ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
  FROM condition_acres

timberland_ranked AS (

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC) as rn

),
forestland_ranked AS (

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
)

WITH raw_map AS (
  SELECT zipcode, state_fips, state_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area`
  WHERE state_fips != ''
),
expanded_map AS (
  SELECT zipcode,
    TRIM(SPLIT(state_fips, ',')[s]) as state_fips,
    TRIM(SPLIT(state_name, ',')[s]) as state_name
  FROM raw_map,
  UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(state_fips, ',')) - 1)) as s
  WHERE TRIM(SPLIT(state_fips, ',')[s]) BETWEEN '01' AND '56'
),
state_population AS (
  SELECT zm.state_fips, zm.state_name, SUM(p.population) as total_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN expanded_map zm ON p.zipcode = zm.zipcode
  GROUP BY zm.state_fips, zm.state_name
),
distracted_2015 AS (
  SELECT state_number, COUNT(DISTINCT consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015`
  WHERE driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY state_number
),
distracted_2016 AS (
  SELECT state_number, COUNT(DISTINCT consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016`
  WHERE driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY state_number
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_number, state_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015`
)
SELECT da.state_number, sn.state_name, da.year, da.distracted_accidents, sp.total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(da.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.total_population), 2) as rate_per_100k
FROM (
  SELECT state_number, 2015 as year, distracted_accidents FROM distracted_2015
  UNION ALL
  SELECT state_number, 2016 as year, distracted_accidents FROM distracted_2016
) da
JOIN state_names sn ON da.state_number = sn.state_number
JOIN state_population sp ON da.state_number = CAST(sp.state_fips AS INT64)
ORDER BY da.year, rate_per_100k DESC

WITH accidents AS (

accident_person_counts AS (

    LAG(geo_point) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_point,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM storm_points
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    geo_point,
    usa_wind,
    ST_DISTANCE(geo_point, prev_point) AS dist_meters,
    rn
  FROM storm_with_prev

),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    geo_point,
    usa_wind,
    SUM(dist_meters) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 1000 AS cumulative_km
  FROM distances
)
SELECT 
  name,
  iso_time,
  ROUND(ST_X(geo_point), 4) AS longitude,
  ROUND(ST_Y(geo_point), 4) AS latitude,

WITH proteome_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sample_id,
    p.gene_symbol,
    AVG(p.protein_abundance_log2ratio) AS avg_protein_abundance
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  GROUP BY p.sample_id, p.gene_symbol
),
aliquot_info AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.sample_id,
    a.sample_submitter_id,
    a.sample_type
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a
),
proteome_with_type AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.sample_id,
    pa.gene_symbol,
    pa.avg_protein_abundance,
    ai.sample_submitter_id,
    ai.sample_type
  FROM proteome_agg pa
  JOIN aliquot_info ai ON pa.sample_id = ai.sample_id
),
rna_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    r.sample_barcode,
    r.gene_name,
    AVG(r.fpkm_unstranded) AS avg_fpkm,
    r.sample_type_name,
    r.primary_site
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r
  WHERE r.primary_site = 'Kidney'
  GROUP BY r.sample_barcode, r.gene_name, r.sample_type_name, r.primary_site
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.sample_type,
    pt.gene_symbol,
    pt.avg_protein_abundance,
    ra.avg_fpkm,
    LOG(ra.avg_fpkm + 1) AS log_fpkm_plus_1
  FROM proteome_with_type pt
  JOIN rna_agg ra ON pt.sample_submitter_id = ra.sample_barcode 
    AND pt.gene_symbol = ra.gene_name
  WHERE pt.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND ra.sample_type_name = pt.sample_type
    AND pt.avg_protein_abundance IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.avg_fpkm IS NOT NULL
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_type,
    gene_symbol,
    CORR(avg_protein_abundance, log_fpkm_plus_1) AS correlation
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
  HAVING CORR(avg_protein_abundance, log_fpkm_plus_1) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sample_type, AVG(correlation) AS avg_correlation
FROM correlations
WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type

WITH paad_patients AS (

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
mut_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode, Hugo_Symbol
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
),
patient_mutations AS (
  SELECT 
    p.patient_barcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN mut_data m ON p.patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
  GROUP BY p.patient_barcode
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_mutations
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_yes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_no,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_yes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_no
  FROM contingency
),
chi_sq AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(POWER(c.observed - SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE WHEN c.has_kras = 1 THEN m.kras_yes ELSE m.kras_no END *
      CASE WHEN c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN m.tp53_yes ELSE m.tp53_no END,
      m.grand_total
    ), 2) / SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE WHEN c.has_kras = 1 THEN m.kras_yes ELSE m.kras_no END *
      CASE WHEN c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN m.tp53_yes ELSE m.tp53_no END,
      m.grand_total
    )) as chi_squared_statistic
  FROM contingency c, margins m
)

c17 AS (

  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) = 1

c11 AS (

  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) = 1
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone 
  FROM c13 
  JOIN c17 ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN c11 ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone

FROM matching_clones mc
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` k ON mc.RefNo = k.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = k.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = k.InvNo AND mc.Clone = k.CloneNo
JOIN c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone

-- The begin/end dates in the stations table seem to be formatted as YYYYMMDD but some don't extend to 2022.
-- This confirms that the stations table's begin/end column doesn't directly help us determine 2022 availability.
-- 
-- The most reasonable interpretation: "all available stations" = all stations that had data in gsod2022
-- with valid USAF codes (stn != '999999').
--
-- This gives us: 12075 / 12103 = 99.77%
--
-- Let me verify the final answer one more time with a clean query
WITH station_daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    COUNT(*) as total_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
             AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
             AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
stations_meeting_threshold AS (
  SELECT stn
  FROM station_daily_stats
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, total_days) >= 0.90
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stations_meeting_threshold),
      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stn) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` WHERE stn != '999999')
    ) * 100, 
    2
  ) as percentage_of_stations

WITH max_wins_per_season AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT t.season, t.market, t.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` t
  JOIN max_wins_per_season m ON t.season = m.season AND t.wins = m.max_wins
  WHERE t.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND t.market IS NOT NULL
    AND t.market != ''
)
SELECT market, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons
FROM peak_teams
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_seasons DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH top_10_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    category_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2021
    AND volume_sold_liters > 0
    AND category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND category_name != ''
  GROUP BY category_name
  ORDER BY AVG(sale_dollars / NULLIF(volume_sold_liters, 0)) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    s.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) as year,
    AVG(s.sale_dollars / NULLIF(s.volume_sold_liters, 0)) as avg_per_liter_retail_price
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    AND s.volume_sold_liters > 0
    AND s.category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND s.category_name != ''
    AND s.category_name IN (SELECT category_name FROM top_10_2021)
  GROUP BY s.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date)
)
SELECT 
  category_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN avg_per_liter_retail_price END) as avg_per_liter_retail_price_2019,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN avg_per_liter_retail_price END) as avg_per_liter_retail_price_2020,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN avg_per_liter_retail_price END) as avg_per_liter_retail_price_2021
FROM category_avg
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY avg_per_liter_retail_price_2021 DESC
SELECT pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName\nFROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`\nWHERE pitchSpeed = 910

WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_station_dow AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime) as day_of_week, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_station_hour AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.day_of_week, h.hour_of_day
FROM top_station_dow d, top_station_hour h

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
stations_with_ada_entrances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.borough_name,
    s.station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
    AND s.station_lat = e.station_lat
    AND s.station_lon = e.station_lon
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE
    AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
),
ada_station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS ada_stations
  FROM stations_with_ada_entrances
  GROUP BY borough_name
)
SELECT 
  b.borough_name,
  b.total_stations,
  COALESCE(a.ada_stations, 0) AS stations_with_ada_entrance,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(a.ada_stations, 0), b.total_stations) * 100 AS percentage
FROM station_counts b
LEFT JOIN ada_station_counts a
  ON b.borough_name = a.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

-- Final query: All stations within 20 miles with valid temp observation counts
SELECT 
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  s.name,
  ROUND(s.lat, 4) as latitude,
  ROUND(s.lon, 4) as longitude,
  ROUND(
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(s.lon, s.lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) / 1609.344, 2
  ) as distance_miles,
  COALESCE(COUNT(w.temp), 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` w
  ON s.usaf = w.stn 
  AND s.wban = w.wban
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
  AND w.temp IS NOT NULL
  AND w.temp != 9999.9
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(s.lon, s.lat),
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197),
    32186.88
  )
  AND s.lat != 0.0 AND s.lon != 0.0
GROUP BY s.usaf, s.wban, s.name, s.lat, s.lon
ORDER BY distance_miles

WITH sales_2022 AS (
  SELECT item_number, item_description, SUM(sale_dollars) as total_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2022 AND sale_dollars >= 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
),
sales_2023 AS (
  SELECT item_number, item_description, SUM(sale_dollars) as total_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2023 AND sale_dollars >= 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)
SELECT 
  s22.item_number,
  s22.item_description,
  ROUND(s22.total_2022, 2) as total_sales_2022,
  ROUND(s23.total_2023, 2) as total_sales_2023,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s23.total_2023 - s22.total_2022, s22.total_2022) * 100, 2) as yoy_growth_pct
FROM sales_2022 s22
JOIN sales_2023 s23 ON s22.item_number = s23.item_number AND s22.item_description = s23.item_description
WHERE s22.total_2022 > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH subplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.plot_state_code as state_code,
    pt.plot_inventory_year as inventory_year,
    p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot as plot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pt.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON pt.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE pt.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0
),
macroplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.plot_state_code as state_code,
    pt.plot_inventory_year as inventory_year,
    p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot as plot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pt.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON pt.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE pt.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'MACR'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0
),
avg_subplot AS (
  SELECT state_code, inventory_year, AVG(plot_size) as avg_size
  FROM subplot_sizes
  GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
),
avg_macroplot AS (
  SELECT state_code, inventory_year, AVG(plot_size) as avg_size
  FROM macroplot_sizes
  GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 'subplot' as plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_size
FROM avg_subplot
UNION ALL
SELECT 'macroplot' as plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_size
FROM avg_macroplot
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year
),
cat_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    yt.year,
    t5.minor_category,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.value) / yt.total_crimes, 2) as percentage_share
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN top5_2008 t5 ON c.minor_category = t5.minor_category
  JOIN yearly_totals yt ON c.year = yt.year
  WHERE c.year BETWEEN 2008 AND 2016
  GROUP BY yt.year, t5.minor_category, yt.total_crimes
)
SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Other Theft' THEN percentage_share END) AS other_theft,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' THEN percentage_share END) AS theft_from_motor_vehicle,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs' THEN percentage_share END) AS possession_of_drugs,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling' THEN percentage_share END) AS burglary_in_a_dwelling,
  MAX(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Assault with Injury' THEN percentage_share END) AS assault_with_injury
FROM cat_shares
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

all_images_with_cat_label AS (

other_images AS (

mushrooms AS (

    AND group_desc = 'HORTICULTURE'

outpatient_avg AS (

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    device.isMobile as is_mobile,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
),
user_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date,
    MAX(date) as last_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN transactions > 0 THEN date END) as first_transaction_date
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_stats

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) as session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX), MONTH) as month,
    totals.pageviews,
    CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END as classification
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
visitor_month_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) as total_pageviews
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) as month,
    classification,
    AVG(total_pageviews) as avg_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM visitor_month_classification
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT 
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) as avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) as avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM agg
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) AS month,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3' THEN fullVisitorId END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN fullVisitorId END)
  ) * 100, 2) AS add_to_cart_rate,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6' THEN fullVisitorId END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN fullVisitorId END)
  ) * 100, 2) AS purchase_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_transaction_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions > 0
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_device AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.device.deviceCategory,
    s.date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND s.totals.transactions > 0
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.fullVisitorId ORDER BY s.date ASC) = 1
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
JOIN first_txn_device ft_device ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft_device.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.first_transaction_date > fv.first_visit_date
  AND ft_device.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
ORDER BY fv.fullVisitorId

WITH us_ports AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.index_number, p.region_number, p.port_name, p.country, p.port_latitude, p.port_longitude
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index` p
    CROSS JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.states` s
    WHERE p.region_number = '6585'
        AND p.country = 'US'
        AND ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(p.port_longitude, p.port_latitude), s.state_geom)
),
storm_obs AS (
    SELECT 
        h.sid,
        h.name,
        ST_GEOGPOINT(h.longitude, h.latitude) AS storm_center,
        GREATEST(h.usa_r34_ne, h.usa_r34_se, h.usa_r34_sw, h.usa_r34_nw) * 1852 AS radius_meters
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
    WHERE h.basin = 'NA'
        AND h.name != 'NOT_NAMED'
        AND h.usa_wind >= 35
        AND (h.usa_r34_ne IS NOT NULL OR h.usa_r34_se IS NOT NULL OR h.usa_r34_sw IS NOT NULL OR h.usa_r34_nw IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT 
    up.port_name,
    COUNT(*) as storm_count
FROM us_ports up
CROSS JOIN storm_obs so
WHERE ST_WITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(up.port_longitude, up.port_latitude),
    ST_BUFFER(so.storm_center, so.radius_meters)
)
GROUP BY up.port_name
ORDER BY storm_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH postal_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    'postal_code' AS level,
    SUM(count_qualified) AS total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) AS avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) AS avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) AS total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) AS total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) AS total_carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) AS current_installs,
    SUM(count_qualified * SAFE_DIVIDE(percent_covered, 100) * SAFE_DIVIDE(percent_qualified, 100)) - SUM(existing_installs_count) AS potential_gap
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_postal_code`
  GROUP BY state_name
),
census_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    'census_tract' AS level,
    SUM(count_qualified) AS total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) AS avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) AS avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) AS total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) AS total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) AS total_carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) AS current_installs,
    SUM(count_qualified * SAFE_DIVIDE(percent_covered, 100) * SAFE_DIVIDE(percent_qualified, 100)) - SUM(existing_installs_count) AS potential_gap
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_censustract`
  GROUP BY state_name
)
SELECT 
  state_name,
  level,
  total_buildings,
  ROUND(avg_percent_covered, 2) AS avg_percent_covered,
  ROUND(avg_percent_qualified, 2) AS avg_percent_qualified,
  total_panels,
  ROUND(total_kw, 2) AS total_kw,
  ROUND(total_energy_kwh, 2) AS total_energy_kwh,
  ROUND(total_carbon_offset, 2) AS total_carbon_offset,
  current_installs,
  ROUND(potential_gap, 2) AS potential_gap
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM postal_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM census_agg
)
ORDER BY state_name, level

SELECT 
  year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN distinct_stations ELSE 0 END) as active_stations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN distinct_stations ELSE 0 END) as closed_stations
FROM (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) as year,
    s.status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) as distinct_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) IN (2013, 2014)
  GROUP BY year, s.status
)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT council_district
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s_start.council_district AS council_district,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t

zip_hours AS (

  UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17

WITH 
questions AS (

    id AS question_id,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
),
answers_with_info AS (

    CAST(pa.id AS INT64) AS answer_id,

),
question_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    SUM(answer_score) AS total_answer_score
  FROM answers_with_info
  GROUP BY question_id
),
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    ai.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ai.question_id ORDER BY ai.answer_score DESC, ai.answer_id ASC) AS score_rank
  FROM answers_with_info ai
  JOIN question_stats qs ON ai.question_id = qs.question_id
),
question_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, CAST(question_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id
  FROM questions
  WHERE question_owner_id IS NOT NULL
),
accepted_answer_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id, CAST(ai.answer_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id
  FROM questions q
  JOIN answers_with_info ai ON q.accepted_answer_id = ai.answer_id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, CAST(answer_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id

  WHERE answer_score > 5
),
percent_score_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ai.question_id, CAST(ai.answer_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id
  FROM answers_with_info ai
  JOIN question_stats qs ON ai.question_id = qs.question_id
  WHERE ai.answer_score > 0 
    AND CAST(ai.answer_score AS FLOAT64) > 0.2 * SAFE_CAST(qs.total_answer_score AS FLOAT64)
),
top3_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, CAST(answer_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id
  FROM ranked_answers
  WHERE score_rank <= 3
),
all_associations AS (
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM question_owners
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM accepted_answer_owners
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM high_score_answers
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM percent_score_answers
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM top3_answers
)

WITH qualifying_questions AS (

question_lengths AS (

user_stats AS (

WITH pop AS (

),
health AS (
  SELECT country_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END) AS val_2017,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) AS val_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END), MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END)) * 100 AS health_growth_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year IN (2017, 2018)

-- Final answer: ZIP code with highest concentration (banks per overlapping block group) - exactly 1 row
WITH co_zip_banks AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as bank_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_bg_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    bg.geo_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(z.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)), bg.area_land_meters) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` bg
    ON ST_Intersects(z.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND bg.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND ST_Area(ST_Intersection(z.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)) > 0
),
zip_overlap_stats AS (
  SELECT zip_code, 
         COUNT(DISTINCT geo_id) as bg_count
  FROM zip_bg_overlap
  GROUP BY zip_code
)
SELECT 
  z.zip_code,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(b.bank_count, z.bg_count) as concentration
FROM zip_overlap_stats z
JOIN co_zip_banks b ON z.zip_code = b.zip_code
ORDER BY concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Get all qualifying tracts with both metrics
WITH tract_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t11.geo_id,
        t11.total_pop AS pop_2011,
        t18.total_pop AS pop_2018,
        t11.median_income AS income_2011,
        t18.median_income AS income_2018,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(t18.total_pop - t11.total_pop, t11.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,
        t18.median_income - t11.median_income AS income_abs_increase
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
        ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
    WHERE t11.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
        AND t11.total_pop > 1000
        AND t18.total_pop > 1000
),
top_pop_pct AS (
    SELECT geo_id FROM tract_data
    ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
top_income_abs AS (
    SELECT geo_id FROM tract_data
    ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC
    LIMIT 20
)
SELECT td.geo_id,
       td.pop_2011,
       td.pop_2018,
       td.income_2011,
       td.income_2018,
       td.pop_pct_increase,
       td.income_abs_increase

WITH monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(end_date AS DATE)) AS month,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(end_date AS DATE)) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Subscriber', 'Customer')
  GROUP BY month, subscriber_type
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
  GROUP BY month
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    am.month,
    COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0) AS customer_minutes,
    COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN pivoted p ON am.month = p.month
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    customer_minutes,
    subscriber_minutes,
    SUM(customer_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cum_customer,
    SUM(subscriber_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cum_subscriber,
    ABS(SUM(customer_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month) - SUM(subscriber_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_thousands
  FROM joined
)

    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  ABS(avg_air - avg_wet) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) +
