-- Final query with deterministic ordering
WITH 
sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
pe_with_tas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe_to.pe_stable_id, pe.uniprot_id,
    CASE WHEN pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN 'target' ELSE 'non-target' END as pe_type
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pe_to.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE pe_to.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
target_uniprot_per_pathway AS (
  SELECT pe_to.pathway_stable_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id) as targets_in_pathway
  FROM pe_with_tas pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to ON pe.pe_stable_id = pe_to.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pe.pe_type = 'target'
  GROUP BY pe_to.pathway_stable_id
),
non_target_pe_per_pathway AS (
  SELECT pe_to.pathway_stable_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.pe_stable_id) as non_targets_in_pathway
  FROM pe_with_tas pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to ON pe.pe_stable_id = pe_to.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pe.pe_type = 'non-target'
  GROUP BY pe_to.pathway_stable_id
),
total_non_targets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe_stable_id) as total_non_target_pes
  FROM pe_with_tas
  WHERE pe_type = 'non-target'
),
all_pathways AS (
  SELECT p.stable_id as pathway_stable_id, p.name as pathway_name
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p
  WHERE p.lowest_level = TRUE
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to
      WHERE pe_to.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id AND pe_to.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    )
)

SELECT 
  ap.pathway_stable_id,
  ap.pathway_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    POWER((COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) * (tn.total_non_target_pes - COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)) - (40 - COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0)) * COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)), 2) * (40 + tn.total_non_target_pes),
    40.0 * tn.total_non_target_pes * (COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) + COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)) * ((40 - COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0)) + (tn.total_non_target_pes - COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)))
  ) as chi_squared,
  COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) as targets_in_pathway,
  40 - COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) as targets_outside_pathway,
  COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0) as non_targets_in_pathway,
  tn.total_non_target_pes - COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0) as non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM all_pathways ap
LEFT JOIN target_uniprot_per_pathway tp ON ap.pathway_stable_id = tp.pathway_stable_id
LEFT JOIN non_target_pe_per_pathway np ON ap.pathway_stable_id = np.pathway_stable_id
CROSS JOIN total_non_targets tn
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC, ap.pathway_stable_id ASC
LIMIT 3

-- The question says "average number of shot attempts" and "average number of successful shots"
-- Given the phrasing, I think it's asking for:
-- For each shot type:
--   - average adjusted x coordinate
--   - average adjusted y coordinate  
--   - average attempts per game (or just count of attempts)
--   - average successful shots per game (or just count of successful shots)
--
-- But re-reading again: "the average number of shot attempts" - this could simply mean 
-- the count of shot attempts (since it's already an average in the sense of per shot type group).
-- 
-- Actually, I think the most natural reading is:
-- shot_type, avg_x, avg_y, total_attempts, total_successful_shots
-- 
-- The word "average" in "average number of shot attempts" might just be imprecise language
-- meaning "count" or "total". Let me go with the simpler interpretation: 
-- shot_type, avg_adjusted_x, avg_adjusted_y, total_attempts, successful_shots_count
--
-- But wait - the question also says "considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, 
-- excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the 
-- correct side of the court based on the team's basket"
--
-- The "correct side of the court based on the team's basket" part - this is what the 
-- coordinate adjustment does (using the x < 564 logic from the documentation).
-- The documentation says:
-- - If event_coord_x < 564: Use event_coord_x directly for X, 600 - event_coord_y for Y
-- - Otherwise: 1128 - event_coord_x for X, event_coord_y for Y
--
-- This already adjusts for the left/right basket. So the coordinate adjustment handles
-- the "correct side" requirement.

-- Let me finalize with the most straightforward interpretation
SELECT 
    shot_type,

WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value,
    a.standard_type,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL 
    AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.pchembl_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
heavy_atom_molecules AS (
  SELECT molregno, CAST(heavy_atoms AS INT64) AS heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29`
  WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL 
    AND heavy_atoms != ''
    AND CAST(heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT fa.*, h.heavy_atoms
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN heavy_atom_molecules h ON fa.molregno = h.molregno
),
assay_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_activities,
    SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) AS dup_activities
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING total_activities < 5 AND dup_activities < 2
),
valid_activities AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN assay_counts ac ON f.assay_id = ac.assay_id AND f.standard_type = ac.standard_type
),
valid_docs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT doc_id FROM valid_activities
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    d.doc_id,
    d.journal,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.year AS INT64), 1970) AS year,
    CAST(d.first_page AS INT64) AS first_page,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.journal, COALESCE(CAST(d.year AS INT64), 1970) ORDER BY CAST(d.first_page AS INT64)) AS pct_rank
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29` d
  WHERE d.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM valid_docs)
    AND d.year IS NOT NULL AND d.year != ''
),
doc_pub_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    year AS pub_year,
    CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', 
           LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(pct_rank * 11) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
           LPAD(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pct_rank * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ) AS pub_date
  FROM doc_dates
),
compound_smiles AS (
  SELECT molregno, canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29`
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    v1.activity_id AS activity_id_1,
    v2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
    v1.assay_id,
    v1.standard_type,
    v1.molregno AS molregno_1,
    v2.molregno AS molregno_2,
    v1.standard_value AS sv1,
    v2.standard_value AS sv2,
    v1.standard_relation AS sr1,
    v2.standard_relation AS sr2,
    v1.heavy_atoms AS ha1,
    v2.heavy_atoms AS ha2,
    v1.doc_id AS doc_id_1,
    v2.doc_id AS doc_id_2
  FROM valid_activities v1
  JOIN valid_activities v2 
    ON v1.assay_id = v2.assay_id 
    AND v1.standard_type = v2.standard_type
    AND v1.activity_id < v2.activity_id
    AND v1.molregno != v2.molregno
),
paired_with_details AS (
  SELECT 
    p.activity_id_1,
    p.activity_id_2,
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    p.sv1,
    p.sv2,
    p.sr1,
    p.sr2,
    p.ha1,
    p.ha2,
    p.doc_id_1,
    p.doc_id_2,
    cs1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
    cs2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
    CASE WHEN p.ha1 >= p.ha2 THEN p.ha1 ELSE p.ha2 END AS max_heavy_atoms,
    CASE 
      WHEN p.sr1 = p.sr2 AND p.sv1 = p.sv2 THEN 'no-change'
      WHEN p.sr1 = p.sr2 AND p.sv1 > p.sv2 THEN 'decrease'
      WHEN p.sr1 = p.sr2 AND p.sv1 < p.sv2 THEN 'increase'
      ELSE 'no-change'
    END AS change_type,
    CASE WHEN p.doc_id_1 >= p.doc_id_2 THEN p.doc_id_1 ELSE p.doc_id_2 END AS highest_doc_id,
    dp1.pub_date AS pub_date_1,
    dp2.pub_date AS pub_date_2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN compound_smiles cs1 ON p.molregno_1 = cs1.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_smiles cs2 ON p.molregno_2 = cs2.molregno
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dp1 ON p.doc_id_1 = dp1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dp2 ON p.doc_id_2 = dp2.doc_id
)
SELECT 
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  max_heavy_atoms,
  CASE WHEN pub_date_1 >= pub_date_2 THEN pub_date_1 ELSE pub_date_2 END AS latest_pub_date,
  highest_doc_id,
  change_type,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, smiles_1, activity_id_2, smiles_2)))) AS mmp_delta_uuid
FROM paired_with_details
ORDER BY activity_id_1, activity_id_2

WITH first_session_per_user AS (

),

    AND fsu.first_session_date >= DATE('2018-07-09')
    AND fsu.first_session_date <= DATE('2018-09-17')

    AND fs.event_name = 'session_start'

WITH session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,

  FROM (
    SELECT 
      (SELECT CAST(v.value.int_value AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS v WHERE v.key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
      ep.key,
      ep.value.string_value AS val_string
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` AS e
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.event_params) AS ep
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
      AND ep.key IN ('source', 'medium', 'campaign', 'ga_session_id')
  )
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(COALESCE(campaign, '')), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(COALESCE(campaign, '')), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
)

WITH first_quickplay AS (

  HAVING DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date)), WEEK(MONDAY)) = DATE '2018-07-02'

  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.cohort_week,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), WEEK(MONDAY)) as activity_week

    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
),
-- Step 3: Count distinct users per cohort_week + activity_week
weekly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week,
    activity_week,
    DATE_DIFF(activity_week, cohort_week, WEEK) as week_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as retained_users
  FROM user_weekly_activity
  GROUP BY cohort_week, activity_week
),
-- Step 4: Get cohort size
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as new_users FROM cohort_users
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('Week ', CAST(week_number AS STRING)) as week,
  cs.new_users as total_new_users,
  wc.retained_users
FROM weekly_counts wc
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
WHERE week_number BETWEEN 0 AND 4

WITH user_first_session AS (

  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`

    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id

user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(first_session_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) as cohort_week_monday
  FROM user_first_session
),
user_session_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) as session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
cohort_weeks AS (

  FROM user_cohort
),
cohort_4th_week AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_week_monday, INTERVAL 21 DAY) as week4_start,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_week_monday, INTERVAL 27 DAY) as week4_end
  FROM cohort_weeks
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_week_monday,
    COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id) as cohort_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN usd.session_date >= c4w.week4_start AND usd.session_date <= c4w.week4_end 
      THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
    END) as retained_users
  FROM user_cohort uc
  JOIN cohort_4th_week c4w ON uc.cohort_week_monday = c4w.cohort_week_monday
  LEFT JOIN user_session_dates usd ON uc.user_pseudo_id = usd.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_week_monday
)
SELECT 
  cohort_week_monday as cohort_date
FROM retention
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(retained_users, cohort_size) DESC

WITH page_views AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`

split_urls AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_location,
    page_title,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') as url_parts
  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    CASE
      WHEN page_location IS NULL THEN page_title
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(url_parts) >= 6 THEN
        CASE
          WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'\+')
               AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(4)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
                    OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)'))
          THEN 'PDP'
          WHEN NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(4)], r'\+')
               AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'\+')
               AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(4)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
                    OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)'))

),

    SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) as group_id
  FROM with_change_flag
),
merged AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_ts,
    display_label,
    group_id
  FROM with_groups
  GROUP BY display_label, group_id

  '1362228.4966015575' as user_pseudo_id,

FROM merged
